title: Correct original length
description: Essential: Student must state or calculate the original length as 0.10 m or 10 cm.

title: Correct spring constant
description: Essential: Student must state or calculate the spring constant as 1000 N/m.

title: Apply Hooke's Law correctly
description: Important: Student must write both force equations: F₁ = k(l₀ - l₁) for compression and F₂ = k(l₂ - l₀) for stretching.

title: Solve simultaneous equations
description: Important: Student must show a valid method to solve the two equations for both unknowns (l₀ and k).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student should convert all lengths to consistent units (e.g., meters) before solving.

title: Sign error in Hooke's Law
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly writes the compression equation as F₁ = k(l₁ - l₀) or similar sign mistake.

title: Misinterpret equilibrium lengths
description: Pitfall: Student treats l₁ and l₂ as displacements rather than final equilibrium lengths.
